notes.title: Update
notes.content:
[p]Fix to UI.  Team selection tab, technical attributes was showing incorrect headings.
This is now fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Build ID : 18926348[/p]

notes.title: New Additions!
notes.content: [h3]More main menu options[/h3][p]More direct main menu options to take you where you want to go.[/p][p][/p][h3]A Darker UI mode toggle in Settings.[/h3][p]Where possible the in-game UI uses darker colours instead of team colours[/p][p][/p][h3]Name markers above heads in 3D match.[/h3][p]With different selections in SETTINGS.[/p][p]The default settings are show numbers for both teams.[/p][p][/p][p]        Squad HUD toggle on/off.[/p][p]        Show Numbers.[/p][p]        Show Names.[/p][p]        Show opponents team and show my team toggles.[/p][p][/p][h3]Darkened boxes like the advance box.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Player guide is now viewable in game[/h3][p]Accessible via the main menu options.[/p]

notes.title: Update : NCL 3 and France Division 3 Fixes
notes.content:
These competitions are now fixed and will work on New Games.

The NCL 3 fixes may also work on any NCL 3 save games that are in the first season and dated before the final stages of the fixtures.

The France division 3 fix will not apply to any save games or databases created before this build.
The France division 3 fix will only apply to new games and new databases created from this build 18208298 onwards.

Build ID: 18208298

Thanks go to all those who supply save games to assist in the troubleshooting.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
Glitch at fast speed fix, where players would run to the touchlines and then screen would swipe and play would continue with the next move.

Fixed Super League playoffs.

New build ID is 18055192

notes.title: Fixed resetting of transfer bids
notes.content:
Fixed issue with transfer bids resetting after quitting application.

Always verify integrity of files via Steam to ensure you are using the latest build.
Right click the game in the library and select properties.
Select Update, there you can see the Build ID for the release should be 17576498.
If it isn't, go to Installed Files and select Verify integrity of game files or restart the Steam client.

notes.title: Update : Workshop fix for inactive clubs
notes.content:
Discovered an issue with inactive clubs after testing the workshop database called "CUSTOM".
The "CUSTOM" database would fail at the start.
Inactive clubs as a result of whole competitions being removed using the editor would still try to be processed.
Inactive clubs and clubs that don't belong to a competition are now no longer processed.
The "CUSTOM" database will now run.
